L2_abstraction.description: Refactor internal helpers or client abstractions without shipping new operator-facing smoke, review, or rollout surfaces.
pros: Could reduce some scenario helper duplication
cons: Would not satisfy the explicit rollout validation and documentation requirements

L3_operating_surface.description: Add stable scenario commands, review bundles, and operator docs that run directly against the shipped org surfaces.
pros: Matches the requested stabilization path directly
Creates reusable operator surfaces with bounded changes
cons: Adds scenario and documentation maintenance surface

layer_justification: The missing work is reusable operator validation and rollout surfaces around already-implemented product capabilities, not more internal product logic.
why_not_lower: Manual steps or one-off notes would not create stable smoke/review entrypoints or a canonical rollout reference.
why_not_higher: A larger platform abstraction for scenario orchestration or release tooling would exceed the bounded stabilization objective.
